turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're having game night on Friday, and I need to pick what to buy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one is a big strategy game about building cities, about two hours to play.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a quick party game with drawing and guessing that works for up to ten people.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a cooperative game where everyone works together to stop a spreading disease.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is a word game with cards that's short and pretty easy to learn.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If lots of people are coming, the drawing party game is the safest choice, it's easy and loud and fun. The strategy game is great for a small, serious group. The cooperative game is nice if some people don't enjoy competing.
